required_revisions: Use a verified immutable source artifact rather than mutable project work content.
Bind the handler statically through the governed component registration path.
Require the declared train_panel_csv input and enforce a read-path allowlist before accepting any path.
Provide an execution backend that enforces read confinement, output confinement, and network/subprocess denial.
Use valid BudgetEstimate fields and enforce the declared resource envelope.
Use a strict Pydantic configuration model and reconcile dependencies with the declared project environment.
rationale: Independent review found that the current component execution layer confines outputs but does not establish benchmark-safe read isolation or enforce the declared network/subprocess containment. A component configuration can select arbitrary local paths. This crosses the protected-benchmark containment boundary and cannot be automatically approved. The synthetic acceptance test passed, but does not prove the missing execution containment.
